# Endoscopy recovery beds

!!! info "Definition"
    A daycase endoscopy recovery bed is a short-stay recovery space used to monitor and care for patients following endoscopic procedures before discharge, typically within a dedicated endoscopy recovery area.

## Activity classification

Activity is limited to daycase spells with a primary procedure code in one of the
following groups:

* Oesophagoscopy: G14, G15, G16, G17, G18, G19, G20
* Oesophagogastroduodenoscopy (OGD): G42, G43, G44, G45, G46
* Duodenoscopy: G54, G55
* Jejunoscopy: G64, G65
* Ileoscopy: G79, G80
* Sigmoidoscopy: H23, H24, H25, H26, H27, H28, H37, H69, H70, H71
* Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP): J38, J39, J40, J41, J42, J43, J44, J45
* Colonoscopy: H20, H21, H22, H68
* Bronchoscopy: E48, E49, E50, E51

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

Convert qualifying daycase spells into recovery occupancy hours using the assumed
recovery time.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Occupancy hours}
    =
    \text{Daycase spells}
    \times
    \frac{\text{Recovery time (minutes)}}{60}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Calculate the required number of recovery beds by dividing occupancy hours by the
product of the service's annual operational hours and the assumed occupancy rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    &\text{Required endoscopy recovery beds} \\
    &=
    \frac{\text{Occupancy hours}}
    {\text{Annual operational hours} \times \text{Occupancy rate}}
    \end{aligned}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All groups | Length of stay | Pathway |
| All groups | Occupancy rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational hours | Operational |
